x: Mike Scamell and John Newnham are soon in and our hopes of retaining the team title look good, Steve Marshall, Mike Nicholls and Edie Crossingham are next home all under 50 mins. and then Martin Hills and Joe Scamell.
Gordon Vale and the much improved Phil Vesty of Leicester with Mike Nicholls and Stephen Marshall backing up it was the Belgrave Title again.

Nevertheless Mike Nicholls and Steve Marshall (16th & 17th) came through well to complete the team. We were the first club to finish four, but our Midland rivals, Leicester W.C. soon had their fourth man in to give them a three point victory.
NOVEMBER 20th 1982 - BATTERSEA PARK - LONDON VIDARIANS 7 MILE. This inter club meeting provided a sharpener for John Newnham and Stephen Marshall for the following weeks home open walk.
With Paul Blagg absent Stephen Marshall gallantly tried to take the title but failed as previous winner Hodkinson pulled away in the later stages.

Derek Crookes receives the South London News Group Award from Mick Ledbury which was presented to Belgrave's walkers for'Outstanding Sports Achievements' earlier in the year. Also L. to R. are; Paul Blagg, Stephan Marshall,Paul Warburton, Carl Lawton, Ron Day, John Newnham, John Hall.
Congratulations to Richard Dorman and Stephen Marshall on gaining British Vests during the year. Regretably Stephen has had his year torn apart due to work commitments.

Coming up through in the longer events and behind Stephen Marshall in the Barking was Michael Feighan breaking the cadets course record, he also had the audacity to finish 3rd Belgrave man in the club 20m run.

And there is Stephen Marshall too, who, having had his work commitments reduced should be back in the spotlight. John Hall has had to lie low for a while due to varicose vein problems but is now back on the road.
